caption: The same job on two machines: the 20 s serial part is fixed, the 80 s parallel part becomes 20 s on 4 cores but only 40 s on 2 nodes, and the cluster adds 10 s message overhead. The SMP finishes in 40 s, the cluster in 70 s.

spec.aria: Gantt chart of the worked example: on a 4-core SMP, 20 s serial plus 20 s parallel ends at 40 s; on a 2-node cluster, 20 s serial plus 40 s parallel plus 10 s message overhead ends at 70 s.
